notes_for_editor: The 1934 and 1945 dates agree across all sources, but the three lookout-history sources share lineage (the Clearwater list draws partly on Rex Kamstra's firelookout.com site and cites Ray Kresek's book), so they are not fully independent. The story says so. No staffing is documented in any source. No source describes what remains at the summit or whether the land is open to the public, so access is left out beyond the hike-in note. The 15.2 m height is converted from the 50 ft figure. The brief's kind 'tower' and status 'gone' match the sources.
